name: W Trek
why: Five days, the three great sights of the park in one line: Base Torres, the French Valley and Grey Glacier, sleeping in huts or camps.
book: Every night must be booked before you enter the park: Las Torres (Fantástico Sur) runs the east huts and camps, Vertice the west ones, CONAF the free camps. In high season they sell out months ahead.
water: At every hut and from streams; meals can be booked at the huts.
dangers: Wind: gusts over 100 km/h around Paine Grande and Lago Pehoé several days a summer; rangers close sections.
The weather changes four times a day: waterproofs on top of the pack, always.
turnaround: On the days with the side valleys (Base Torres, French Valley) leave your big pack at the hut and decide at the junction.

points.name: Hotel Las Torres, Torres del Paine
points.note: Day 1: up the Ascencio valley to Refugio Chileno or Campamento Torres; Base Torres at sunrise on day 2.

points.name: Refugio Los Cuernos on Lago Nordenskjöld
points.note: Day 2: along Lago Nordenskjöld under the Cuernos to the hut on the shore.

points.name: Valle del Francés, Mirador Británico
points.note: Day 3: up the French Valley without your pack, back down to Paine Grande.

points.name: Refugio Paine Grande on Lago Pehoé
points.note: The hut by the catamaran pier: where you leave if you end here.

points.name: Glaciar Grey
points.note: Day 4-5: to Refugio Grey and the hanging bridges over the glacier, then back to the Paine Grande catamaran.
